name: simple-drawing-pad
description: Like dictation, but drawn - a quick sketch takes your idea to Claude or any app. Ctrl+Alt+D = draw · Enter = copy · Ctrl+V = paste · Shift+Enter = save as. Nothing is collected and nothing goes to third parties. The small helper comes from the Microsoft Store (signed by Microsoft) or is built from the included source; it asks once before installing. A short local check runs at each session start. Remove: /simple-drawing-pad:uninstall.
